scene: Kitchen table in the afternoon. Dad sits at screen-left; Child stands beside the table at screen-right. A small paper shopping list lies flat at table center and is only touched at the end. Locked 16:9 medium two-shot with both faces visible.

emotion.baseline: Calm, warm and regulated baseline. Both speak at a normal family volume with small, natural facial movements and gestures.
emotion.allowed_shift: Child asks with warm, lively interest about the family trip; Dad answers in a planning tone; both end satisfied with the plan.
emotion.forbidden: No exaggerated surprise, wide-eyed shock, bouncing, raised voices, impatience, blaming or teasing. Any disappointment, worry or sadness stays mild and brief, and the adult helps things stay steady.

clips.start: Dad sits with the paper list flat at center; Child stands beside the table with empty hands.
clips.action: Dad announces the picnic. Child counts the coming people on his fingers while asking who; Dad raises three fingers in answer.
clips.end: Dad sits with one hand near the list; Child's counting hand relaxes.

clips.start: Dad sits with one hand near the list; Child stands with empty hands.
clips.action: Child taps the table edge twice while asking the leaving time; Dad points at her watch. Child opens both palms while asking what to bring; Dad gestures a small sharing bowl with cupped hands.
clips.end: Dad's cupped hands rest near the list; Child looks at her, thinking.

clips.start: Dad's cupped hands rest near the list; Child looks at her, thinking.
clips.action: Child mimes placing two small cakes into cupped hands while offering his berry cakes. Dad turns the paper list toward Child and adds a short note; Child watches the pencil move.
clips.end: The paper list lies turned toward Child with a new short note; Dad's pencil rests on the table; Child stands with empty hands and a pleased smile.
